notes.title: Creepy Castle 1.121
notes.content:
Hey guys, just a small update. Sorry for how long it took but I'm happy to share some new stuff with you and let you know there's more on the way.

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Updated storage method of game text for future translations. No solid dates yet, but hopefully we will have Japanese and Korean sooner than later.
    [*]Some cameo NPCs have been added.
    [*]You can now use the shoulder buttons on your controller or A/S in the Struggle duel.
    [*]Glitch that would trap you after getting an easter egg in The Final Fist is fixed.
    [*]Butterfly is now a trans boy to better reflect my real life Butterfly.
    [*]The start of something new?
[/list]

That "something new" is a very small teaser for an upcoming non-canon scenario called Meta Town. It'll pay tribute to the great fanbase this game has and I'll be asking you guys for some community involvement in its creation, too. Beyond that, there will also be another canon scenario featuring an all-new character and locale that will kick off Season 2.

Updates on the technical side: we're getting closer to Mac and Linux. Also,due to it being probably the most contentious aspect of the game, I will be making the map system less cryptic. I wanted to try and lead the player to rely more on mental mapping, landmarks and a vague sense of where they had been, which is why the map was made so low-tech, but I feel like this element of the game was the cause of the biggest hangups, so I'll be souping it up. I hope those who want a more comprehensive map system will be excited.

There will be some more fun to be had in Creepy Castle over the summer. I hope you look forward to it!

Zach

notes.title: CREEPY CASTLE 1.1 - "THE FINAL FIST" RELEASED!
notes.content:
Hey there, everyone! Creepy Castle has been updated to 1.1 on Steam. The update features a short new scenario, The Final Fist, which ties up the plot of the game's "first season". To access The Final Fist, you'll need to have beaten four prerequisite scenarios: 1, 2, 2B and 4- that's Creepy Castle, Ghostly Mystery, Lost and Due Exaltation.

There's other features, changes and bugfixes, too!

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
    [*]ADDED SCENARIO 5- "THE FINAL FIST", the grand finale of Creepy Castle's tale!
    [*]Added achievements for completing Depth (works retroactively) and The Final Fist.
    [*]Changed Sumo "Action" button indicator to a sword.
    [*]Ant Queen now has her own dialogue noise, so conversations are easier to follow.
    [*]Dialogue tweaked a little in 2B.
    [*]More illustrations added to Due Exaltation's ending cutscene.
    [*]Added a save point before Monsoon as people often die there.
    [*]Dr. Philo's services have been tweaked a bit- you may no longer donate. More tweaks to come.
    [*]More balance tweaks are to come.
[/list]
